name: Comp S.A.
summary: Comp S.A., a technology firm, engages in the digital security systems and retail management systems in Poland. It operates through Secure IT and Retail RegTech segments. The Secure IT segments provides comprehensive design, implementation, consulting, and training services related to IT security management; optimized and secure network infrastructure; and comprehensive IT solutions, as well as consulting services based on mass storage systems, backup and archiving systems, Storage Area Networks, and high-availability systems, IT management, and quality management systems.
